title: Cape Breton Backcountry Adventures

services.name: Cruise Ship Tours
services.desc: This private Jeep tour is designed specifically for cruise ship guests looking to experience Cape Breton beyond the port while remaining aligned with ship schedules. The experience offers scenic driving, hidden viewpoints, and local storytelling, all delivered in a relaxed and reliable format. Routes and timing are customized based on ship arrival and departure, ensuring guests return comfortably within their schedule. This tour is ideal for travelers who want a meaningful, private experience to the most scenic spots on the Island without the stress of large bus tours. services.name: Heli Fly Fishing Adventure
services.desc: The Heli Fly Fishing Adventure is a premium, once in a lifetime experience combining helicopter access with guided fly fishing in remote Cape Breton locations. This exclusive adventure is designed for anglers seeking solitude, untouched water, and a truly unique way to experience the island’s wilderness. Guests are transported into the mountains of Margaree by helicopter, then transported by Jeep to carefully selected fishing locations where they will enjoy a fully guided fly fishing experience with professional instruction and all equipment provided. services.name: Luxury Eco Stay & Jeep Excursion
services.desc: Slow down and explore the Cabot Trail on a two-night getaway that blends eco-luxury accommodations, local flavours, and a private Jeep adventure. Settle into Sally's Brook Luxury Eco-Resort & Wilderness Cabins, choosing Raven's Roost, a cozy woodland retreat, or Eagle's Nest, a modern cabin with panoramic views. Then set out on a guided Jeep tour with Cape Breton Backcountry Adventures, with return transportation included. Discover the Margaree Valley's mountain lookoffs, river valleys, quiet backroads, and hidden gems as your local guide shares stories of the area's history and culture.
